description: Create a downloadable SimpleFeed export file (JSON, CSV, or Markdown) and return an https resource_link for that file. The link is short-lived (about 2 hours) and uses an unguessable token; it is not gated to the signed-in account — anyone with the URL can open it until it expires. Does not count against search quota.

content.description: Full export text (JSON, CSV, or Markdown).

mime_type.description: MIME type, e.g. application/json, text/csv, text/markdown.

name: export_file
title: Export file
